However I never expected to be able to see such a story or characters of that scale, especially a female character, come up on screen in our own Malayalam during my lifetime. In that sense, watching Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra has been a dream come true. The makers have done an amazing and solid job of taking inspiration out of such works to construct a truly *original* story of grandiose scale rooted in Malayalam folklore.
